_rationale: Year 0 IRMAA = 0 (no 2-year-prior MAGI). Year 1 IRMAA = 0 (only one year of history). Year 2 (age 67) IRMAA looks back to year 0's MAGI = $250,000 (pension). Single-filer tier 5 ($193k–$500k) surcharge = ($384.30 + $74.20) × 12 = $5,502 per Medicare enrollee × 1 (single) = $5,502. The simulation auto-creates a Reinvestment taxable account to absorb the year-0 surplus.
